classification.difficultyReason: Copy the supplied outlines, recesses and unit divisions onto the three lattice directions, preserving relative lengths. Even the branched solid requires direct reproduction rather than a new viewpoint or hidden-structure inference.

content.prompt: Draw each of the following on isometric paper.

spec.description: Unshaded black editable isometric row, retaining all three top panels and all visible unit divisions.
Editable isometric dot lattice; preserve drawing space for the complete supplied figure.

answer.worked: Draw the three equal top parallelograms along one sloping lattice direction. Draw equal vertical edges below their visible corners, join the lower edges and retain the unit divisions on the long side.

spec.description: Two two-level columns with top diamonds touching at a central projected vertex; preserves recessed zigzag and visible horizontal unit divisions.
Editable isometric dot lattice; preserve drawing space for the complete supplied figure.

answer.worked: Draw two equal top diamonds at the same height, meeting at one lattice point. Extend the visible vertical edges down two unit intervals. Join their lower endpoints in the same zigzag arrangement and add the halfway unit divisions.

spec.description: Stepped tall isometric solid preserving the three-level left column, four-level right column, triangular visible upper-left region and all visible unit divisions.
Editable isometric dot lattice; preserve drawing space for the complete supplied figure.

answer.worked: Use the vertical and two sloping directions of the dot lattice. Copy the outline, keeping three vertical unit intervals at the left and four at the right. Add the top edges and the visible unit divisions in the same positions as the supplied drawing.

spec.description: Source-faithful projected bent solid, closed compatible depth model; all source-visible boundaries preserved.
Editable isometric dot lattice; preserve drawing space for the complete supplied figure.

answer.worked: Use equal unit steps in the vertical and two sloping directions of the isometric lattice. Copy the outline, then add the visible unit divisions and the recessed corner in the same positions as the supplied drawing.

spec.description: Black, unshaded editable projection of the supplied L-shaped solid, retaining the stem divisions, arm divisions and actual recess.
Editable isometric dot lattice; preserve drawing space for the complete supplied figure.

answer.worked: Use vertical lines and the two sloping directions of the dot lattice. Draw the three-interval stem and the three-interval top arm in the shown directions, keeping their shared corner and the recess beneath the arm. Add the visible unit divisions on the stem, arm and top surface.

spec.description: Black, unshaded editable projection with a divided vertical stem, a rising-right top arm and a distinct rising-left upper projection; both recesses and all visible unit divisions are retained.
Editable isometric dot lattice; preserve drawing space for the complete supplied figure.

answer.worked: Follow the three directions of the dot lattice. Draw the three-interval vertical stem, continue the top arm for three intervals towards the upper right, and reproduce the separate upper-left projection. Keep the recesses beneath the upper projections and add every visible unit division.
